# FQ-DISCRETE-DYNAMICS-DICHOTOMY

The source all-n theorem proves a nonzero imaginary integer numerator by residues modulo five. Native code computes normalized (3+4i)^k/5^k and periodic i^k controls. The integer numerator theorem has not yet been formally connected to the normalized matrix powers, and source declaration flags are excluded as necessity proofs.

Supported: An all-natural-index integer numerator is nonzero in Lean; actual normalized retained powers have unit mass and never equal identity, unlike periodic controls.

Remaining: Prove the recurrence-to-normalized-matrix bridge for all powers, then formulate any closure/topology or generator selection claim. No full dynamics dichotomy is inferred.
